# Meridian Globe Experience - AI Agent Guidance

## Site Overview
Meridian is an interactive 3D globe visualization experience built with Three.js.
The site provides a rotating globe visualization for educational and exploratory purposes.

## Accessibility Features
- Skip link for keyboard navigation to main content
- ARIA labels on interactive elements
- Semantic HTML structure
- Responsive design for mobile and desktop

## Data and Content
- All content is static and served directly from the server
- No user data is collected or stored
- No external APIs are called during normal operation
- Visualization uses publicly available geographic data (simplified)

## Interaction Guidelines for AI Agents
1. The primary interaction is visual - observing the rotating globe
2. Keyboard navigation is available via skip link
3. The visualization is designed to be left running without interaction
4. No forms, inputs, or complex interactions are present

## Technical Details
- Built with HTML5, CSS3, JavaScript ES6
- Uses Three.js r150+ from CDN
- No build process or framework dependencies
- Responsive design using viewport units

## Contact and Policy
- For questions about AI agent interaction, contact site administrators
- This document follows the proposed llms.txt format for AI agent guidance
- Last updated: 2026-10-05
